name: TowerBauer
author: creative_nap
description:
TowerBauer - The ultimative survival game!

In TowerBauer you have to collect resources, build your base and survive the vicious attacks from the monsters at night!

Controls:
E - Use
W/A/S/D - Move
Space - Jump

Also use your personal cannons to shoot at monsters:
E - Use the cannon
W/A/S/D Move the cannon
Space - Shoot
